summary: Frontend regression after PUBLIC_URL=/ fix. CRITICAL requirement (no infinite loading) is fully resolved: /portal/login, /portal/admin/dashboard, /portal/admin/finance, /portal/admin/noc, /portal/admin/documents, /portal/admin/tickets all hard-load and refresh (F5) successfully with no chunk 404s and no stuck 'LOADING' fallback. Admin login works and admin dashboard renders stats/alerts. All new backend-wired features verified in UI: Cash-flow tab with d30/d60/d90 buckets + weekly projection chart, salary-slip link on Salaries tab, drag & drop document upload modal (doc-dropzone + doc-file-input), admin ticket status change to 'closed' persists with system audit message, and NOC panels (threshold-rules, ddos-panel, ddos-run-detect, notif-channels, blackhole-log, ddos-history, netflow sankey) all render without errors. Public landing lead form submits successfully (POST /api/portal/portal-public/leads => 200, 'Permintaan terkirim / Terima kasih' shown).

ui_bugs.issue: Path in task spec does not exist as a route – hard-loading /portal/admin/business shows the public 404 page. Actual admin business surfaces are /portal/admin/documents (Documents), /portal/admin/crm, /portal/admin/projects, /portal/admin/content, /portal/admin/followups. Recommend either adding a redirect from /portal/admin/business -> /portal/admin/documents (default tab) OR updating the task spec.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add redirect route /portal/admin/business -> /portal/admin/documents so the URL referenced in requirements does not 404.

OPTIONAL for full QA coverage: seed a demo client user (e.g. demo@client.com) so client-side routes (/portal/client/domains WHOIS/search/register, /portal/client/tickets close button) can be exercised via UI end-to-end. They could not be tested in this pass because admin role is (correctly) redirected out of /portal/client/* to /portal/admin/dashboard, and only the admin credential is seeded in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
critical_code_review_comments: publicPath fix via PUBLIC_URL=/ is correct and verified – all lazy chunks now load from /static/js/*. No further action needed for the infinite-loading class of bug.
Client-side route guards redirect admin users to admin dashboard for /portal/client/* – behaviour is correct but blocks automated client-flow testing without a seeded client account.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Infinite-loading bug confirmed fixed by PUBLIC_URL=/. Login, admin routes, finance cashflow, NOC panels, documents dropzone, admin ticket close, and public lead form are all working. Client portal WHOIS/search/register on /portal/client/domains and client ticket-close on /portal/client/tickets were NOT exercised because no client user is seeded (admin gets redirected to /portal/admin/dashboard). Ask main agent to seed a demo client (or reuse Demo Client account) if these need UI verification. /portal/admin/business URL returns the public 404 – documents live at /portal/admin/documents.
rca of the issue: Prior infinite-loading root cause was webpack publicPath being relative under CRA when app is hosted at /portal/* – chunk requests resolved to /portal/static/js/*.chunk.js which the ingress served as index.html. Adding PUBLIC_URL=/ in /app/frontend/.env forces absolute /static/js/*.chunk.js paths. Verified this iteration: no *.chunk.js 404s in the network log, Suspense fallback never stays visible on any hard-loaded nested route, and F5 refresh on /portal/admin/finance and /portal/client/domains no longer hangs.
